title: the moveset lock (Combat; tools/movegen)
description: lock.json (the build's fighters) and lock.proposals.json (the proposals), written by tools/movegen/movegen.mjs: for each fighter, each strike cell to its locked moves as [id, [limb, tip, path, target, weight], the key set it is posed on or null]. An id keeps its shape for good: the generator keeps every locked move that is still allowed and fills only the free places; --relock starts over. Cross-check (the generator's): every id here is in the fighter's moveset with the same shape, and every strike move there is here. Policy: closed, except keys starting with an underscore.
